ns2:section.sectionText: Brass Chamber Music NOTE: Due to the nature of music ensembles, required performances will occur at times other than class times, and additional required rehearsals may be announced. NOTE: Prerequisite: Brass Chamber Music Enrollment is limited to those enrolled in applied study in the School of Music. Those not enrolled in applied study and/or chamber music for credit will be prohibited from participation in Brass Chamber Music.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
